title: Stop prepending OMARCHY_PATH/bin to PATH in Hyprland envs

leads.summary: The named ~/.local/bin wrapper still cannot shadow the packaged omarchy-display-text-size on the stock PATH
leads.consequence: With an inherited /usr/bin ahead of ~/.local/bin (the order explicitly tested by Omarchy), removing the Hyprland prepend leaves /usr/bin/omarchy-display-text-size ahead of a ~/.local/bin wrapper. The PR description's monitor-slider example and its implication that the fix itself enables that wrapper do not hold for this supported/default order. ~/bin is not added by env-bootstrap at all. Users who deliberately put their wrapper directory before /usr/bin do benefit. This is a mismatch between the stated outcome and the delivered change, not a regression in existing command resolution.
leads.triage: already in Opus final (F2); corroboration. Its #10552 mention verified factually (sol/related-10552.diff) but not published: #10552 author the author is in author-exclusions.json; reference omitted to avoid a cross-reference event on an opted-out author's PR.

leads.summary: Open PR #7239 directly conflicts with this change and its test in dev-link mode
leads.consequence: #7239 edits the same removed block to keep hl.env("PATH", ...) in dev-link mode. The new test sets OMARCHY_PATH to its non-production checkout ROOT, so if #7239's conditional emission survives the textual merge conflict, this PR's new assert(set.PATH == nil) fails. If this PR's deletion wins, #7239's intended Hyprland dev-link override disappears. The maintainers must choose a single policy and adjust the test accordingly when merging either branch.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified:** no problems found with the change itself. Nothing else in the repository relies on the removed prepend:

- **Production install:** every `/usr/share/omarchy/bin/*` is a symlink to the same name in `/usr/bin` (omarchy-pkgs `pkgbuilds/omarchy/PKGBUILD`), so commands from the `omarchy` package resolve to the same files before and after.
- **Dev-link mode:** `default/bash/env-bootstrap` still prepends `<checkout>/bin`, and uwsm sources it through `/usr/share/uwsm/env.d/10-omarchy` before Hyprland starts (after the reboot that `omarchy-dev-link` asks for), so the checkout's `bin` still comes ahead of `/usr/bin`.
- **Session environment:** `hl.env` calls `setenv()` in the compositor, and spawned processes inherit that environment. With the block gone, keybinds, the shell, terminals and the `import-environment` in `autostart.lua` get the uwsm `PATH` unchanged. `OMARCHY_PATH` is still exported.
- **New test:** it passes on the head, fails with the removed block restored ("envs.lua sets PATH"), and `test/shell` discovers it. The `hyprland-paths`, `dev-env-path`, `dev-link`, `dev-unlink` and `editor-env` tests pass on the head.

### This also fixes #6977 and overlaps open PR #7239

`bin/omarchy` only looks for `omarchy-*` commands in its own directory, and it does not resolve symlinks. Some commands are installed only to `/usr/bin`, for example `omarchy-debug`, `omarchy-debug-idle` and `omarchy-upload-log` from omarchy-settings. So with `/usr/share/omarchy/bin` first on `PATH`, the dispatcher inside Hyprland could not find them:

```text
PATH order in the Hyprland session       omarchy resolves to           omarchy debug
base: /usr/share/omarchy/bin first    -> /usr/share/omarchy/bin/omarchy -> "Unknown Omarchy command" (exit 127)
head: uwsm order, /usr/bin            -> /usr/bin/omarchy               -> runs omarchy-debug
```

This was reproduced with the head's `bin/omarchy` in a synthetic model of the package layout, not in a live session. Open issue #6977 reports this bug. Open PR #7239 fixes it by keeping the prepend only in dev-link mode, and it rewrites the same lines of `envs.lua`.

**Impact:** the two PRs are alternative fixes for the same bug and conflict textually. If #7239's dev-link-only prepend were kept, this PR's new test would fail, because it runs `envs.lua` with `OMARCHY_PATH` set to the repository checkout, which is not `/usr/share/omarchy`.

**Suggested change:** add "Fixes #6977" and mention #7239 in the description, so maintainers can choose one approach.

### The wrapper example needs the user to put their directory first

On a stock install, `env-bootstrap` appends `~/.local/share/mise/shims` and `~/.local/bin` after `/usr/bin` "so system binaries keep precedence". `default/bash/envs` and the SSH `PATH` in `install/config/ssh-command-path.sh` use the same order. A synthetic session model built on the real uwsm `prepare-env.sh`, `10-omarchy`, `env-bootstrap` and `envs.lua` resolved `omarchy-display-text-size` as follows:

```text
session PATH setup                          base resolves to        head resolves to
stock (~/.local/bin after /usr/bin)         package copy            package copy
user prepends ~/.local/bin (uwsm env.d)     package copy            ~/.local/bin wrapper
```

**Impact:** a wrapper in `~/.local/bin` still does not shadow `/usr/bin/omarchy-*` on a stock install, over SSH or a TTY either. The description's example `PATH` puts `~/bin:~/.local/bin` ahead of `/usr/bin`, an order that Omarchy's defaults do not produce. What the PR changes is that a user-chosen order now also holds in the graphical session.

**Suggested change:** say in the description that the user must put their directory ahead of `/usr/bin` (for example in `~/.config/uwsm/env.d/`).

### Smaller notes

- **History correction:** the dev-link-only prepend in `env-bootstrap` and its "just be noise" comment date from `babfafa5`, when the file was created. `64581ec` removed hot dev-link and left `envs.lua` prepending, so the PR's conclusion still holds.
- **Optional test improvement:** the test loads only `default.hypr.envs`. A mutant that added a `PATH` prepend to `default/hypr/omarchy.lua` passed it. Recording `hl.env` calls in `hyprland-default-config-test.sh`, which already loads `default.hypr.omarchy` with a stub `hl`, and asserting that none sets `PATH` would catch that.
- A config reload never removes a value set with `hl.env`, so sessions started before the update keep the prepended `PATH` after `hyprctl reload` until the next login.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** source review of the changed files, the Hyprland Lua config, uwsm env files, `env-bootstrap`, the `omarchy` dispatcher and the related tests, plus UWSM v0.27.0, Hyprland v0.56.2 and the public omarchy-pkgs recipes. Isolated runs covered the new and related tests on the head and base (including a reverted-block mutant and the `test/shell` runner), a session `PATH` model and a dispatcher model with synthetic file trees. No live Hyprland, uwsm or systemd session was run, `/etc/profile` and the mise shims line were not modelled, and the full test suite was not run.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
